company.name: Sila
company.shortDescription: Sila is the leading money API for fintech. An API platform that provides banking and payment infrastructure-as-a-service.
company.description: Sila is the leading money API for fintech. Using our developer-friendly sandbox, bank agency, and embedded compliance, our fintech and crypto customers have gone from MSA signing to live in production with compliant payments in as little as a few weeks. Our money API includes solutions for immediate funds availability risk-free to our customers, even in the most pervasive fraud environments. Our core strength is innovating on top of ACH, the backbone of the US payment system. Harness its power. Make everything else better.

productsAndServices.description: An ACH orchestration service that routes transactions through RTP, FedNow, or Sila’s instant settlement rail to provide immediate settlement for eligible ACH payments.
productsAndServices.name: ACHNow

productsAndServices.description: An API for originating and accepting ACH transfers between bank accounts, supporting standard and same-day payment processing for fintech applications.
productsAndServices.name: ACH Payment API

productsAndServices.description: An API for creating application-based digital wallets, storing value, and transferring funds among wallets and linked bank accounts.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Wallets API

productsAndServices.description: Designated virtual account and routing numbers that support ACH direct deposits, third-party debits, and account-level payment identification.
productsAndServices.name: Virtual Accounts

productsAndServices.description: API-based identity and business verification for onboarding users and organizations, with compliance screening and verification management tools.
productsAndServices.name: Identity Verification (KYC/KYB)

productsAndServices.description: Fraud-monitoring capabilities integrated with money-transfer APIs to help identify and reduce suspicious payment activity and transaction risk.
productsAndServices.name: Fraud Prevention

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,059,363 to $80,352,765, a 15.88x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
